page_summary: This page contains a survey section aimed at gathering organizational background information related to ports. It includes questions about the location of the organization, its type (e.g., port authority, terminal operator), the size of the port or terminal, its designation as a Critical Infrastructure Operator, and the digitization of processes within the organization.
